name: Focused Handler
body:
The intensity of pain you cause keeps your thralls in line.

Prerequisite(s): Pain focus, Rule of the Lash spell-like ability, mesmerist level 15

Benefit(s): Whenever a creature affected by rule of the lash is the only target of your focus, it becomes dazed rather than staggered from high damage. Furthermore, that creature can be ordered to perform tasks that require any skill check.
